instruction: A candid cinematic still, medium-full shot at eye-level, shows a sunny outdoor grassy courtyard with a rustic building and distant church towers. On the left, the man in the open khaki blazer (R1) stands facing right, his blazer open to reveal his bare chest, looking down at his partner. On the right, the woman in the beige midi dress (R2) stands facing left, looking up into his eyes. The man (R1) and the woman (R2) stand close together, holding hands gently on the green lawn. Warm, direct sunlight illuminates the couple, casting soft shadows on the grass.
